incidents.name: DDC handleDeductFee missing access control
incidents.notes: DDC's handleDeductFee(uint256,uint256,address,address) was callable by anyone and moved the fee amount out of an arbitrary holder, so the attacker deducted the whole DDC/USDT pair balance to themselves and sold it.

sources.ref: onchain review: DDC 0x443195AA3a4357242a7427Fc8ce5f20c1E71fcB1 created 2022-08-28T13:29:14Z by 0x1a8def16f2b9a69743fb301f82bd61ddfa65f7f6, unrelated to attack sender 0x5b69f9c6cbb4958008eae46072886e6b9524fdef; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment (the token was less than two hours old). Loss verified onchain: 110,104.66 USDT left the DDC pair 0x4EFdcabA42cC31cF5198ec99BDC025aff1e32Bb0 and 104,600.66 USDT landed on the attack contract.
